summary: Watch a web address, a managed app or a TCP port in the background and get one email when it is up (or down). Watches once, up to 24 hours.

params.name: target
params.description: The web address, the app name, or host:port.

params.name: contains
params.description: Text the page must contain (kind url, expect up).

params.name: label
params.description: A short name for the watcher.

params.name: key
params.description: The watcher's id, such as w-1a2b3c4d.

workflow.explanation: Start a watcher for a URL, app or port.
See its state and whether the email went out.
